_comment: The heavy test groups (QA 0.5.14 P2-11, P3-11; the library tests live in bibliotheek/tests since 0.5.16): the single list that vite.config.ts leaves out of `npm test` and that tools/run-tests.mjs runs per group (npm run test:voorbeelden, npm run test:bibliotheek; CI jobs of the same name). Every src/**/*.test.ts that imports from bibliotheek/ or voorbeelden/ must be in a group (src/qa/testGroups.test.ts).
